profile_provenance: The banking, document-release, and OTCS registry profiles are worked reference examples authored for this package. The NC2.5 profile defines admissibility while OTCS rights, consent, operating-grant, mark-permission, and expected-head data remain typed external evidence; no concrete OTCS deployment data is distributed or required to verify the package.
binding_rule: A profile and declaration are eligible for this reference package only when their core_anchor exactly reproduces the core version, DOI, file name, and SHA-256 above.
derivation_scope: The package translates declared NC2.5 interface and separation constraints into a reusable engineering contract. It neither modifies the core nor infers admissibility from connector similarity.
